description: Accepting tracked changes on a ShareJS doc without the review module, the way the live doc client now does it: an accepted insert is a plain copy after the text and a plain delete of the tracked text, an accepted delete is a re-insert with u and a plain delete, all in one update, followed by a re-anchor of every comment over an accepted insert. Carol (reviewer) and Bob (editor) are the Rust live doc client (live_doc_gate), Alice watches in the CE web editor, Dave listens on a scripted websocket. Carol suggests an insert and two deletes, Bob comments over the inserted text and accepts the insert and the delete after it. Recorded on a throwaway project that is deleted at the end.
